incompleteCases.question: 每个用户标签编号覆盖多少会员、这些会员订单的平均商品单价是多少？会员数包括无订单会员，平均值只用已知商品明细价格。

itemEvidence.finalSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE price > 1000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'SP';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_status) FROM orders;

SELECT order_id, order_item_id, price
FROM order_items ORDER BY price DESC NULLS LAST,order_id,order_item_id LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE freight_value > 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE status = 2;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE status = 4;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE reason_code = 'QUAL';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupons WHERE discount_type = 'fixed';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_categories;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_movements WHERE movement_type = 2;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE macro_region = 'Sudeste';
SELECT SUM(freight_value) FROM order_items;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt), 2) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS cnt FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id) t LIMIT 201
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY cnt DESC,customer_state ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS total
FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST,seller_id LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'delivered') AS delivered, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'canceled') AS canceled FROM orders LIMIT 201
SELECT level_id, ROUND(AVG(points), 2) AS avg_points FROM members GROUP BY level_id ORDER BY level_id LIMIT 201
SELECT macro_region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM regions GROUP BY macro_region ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT campaign_id, budget FROM campaigns ORDER BY budget DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT discount_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM coupons GROUP BY discount_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) FROM refunds LIMIT 201
SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id LIMIT 201
SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id LIMIT 201
SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tickets GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) FROM settlements LIMIT 201

SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM search_logs GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY cnt DESC,keyword ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score >= 4)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS good_rate FROM order_reviews LIMIT 201
SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_purchase_timestamp) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC,week_start ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS freight FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY 1), calendar AS (SELECT generate_series(MIN(m), MAX(m), INTERVAL '1 month') AS m FROM monthly), filled AS (SELECT c.m, COALESCE(m.cnt, 0) AS cnt FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.m = c.m) SELECT m AS month, cnt, cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m) AS mom_change FROM filled ORDER BY m LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS mo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT cur.mo AS month, cur.cnt - prev.cnt AS yoy_change FROM monthly cur JOIN monthly prev ON prev.mo = cur.mo AND prev.yr = 2017 WHERE cur.yr = 2018 ORDER BY cur.mo LIMIT 201

WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS mx FROM orders) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS week_start, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= a.mx::date - INTERVAL '89 days' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < a.mx::date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS dow, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC,dow ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400), 2) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_days DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM refunds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tickets GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', register_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM members WHERE register_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', period_start) AS month, ROUND(SUM(commission), 2) AS total FROM settlements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_purchase_timestamp) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT t.product_category_name_english,ROUND(SUM(oi.price),2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY sales DESC NULLS LAST,t.product_category_name_english ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM members m
LEFT JOIN user_tag_map t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE t.member_id IS NULL;

SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY avg_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.review_score IN (1, 2) GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 201
SELECT m.level_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT t.tag_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS cnt FROM user_tags t LEFT JOIN user_tag_map tm ON tm.tag_id = t.tag_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id = tm.member_id GROUP BY t.tag_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, t.tag_id LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
FROM user_tag_map tm
JOIN user_tags t ON t.tag_id = tm.tag_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = tm.member_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE t.tag_code = 'HIGH_VALUE';
SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_amount), 2) FROM coupon_usages LIMIT 201
SELECT w.warehouse_name, COUNT(s.shipment_id) AS cnt FROM warehouses w FULL JOIN shipments s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT carrier, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 86400), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_days LIMIT 201

SELECT COALESCE(st.category_id, tc.category_id) AS category_id, ROUND((AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600.0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_hours FROM ticket_categories tc FULL JOIN support_tickets st ON st.category_id = tc.category_id GROUP BY COALESCE(st.category_id, tc.category_id) ORDER BY avg_hours DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(st.net_amount), 2) AS net FROM settlements st LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = st.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY net DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT reason_code, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS total FROM refunds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(price+freight_value) AS amount FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id),per_person AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id,ROUND(SUM(t.amount)/NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id),0),2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_totals t ON t.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT customer_unique_id,avg_order_value FROM per_person WHERE avg_order_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC,customer_unique_id LIMIT 10;
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS ctr FROM search_logs LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.product_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM product_price_history WHERE new_price > old_price;

SELECT r.macro_region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers, ROUND(COUNT(o.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 0), 2) AS orders_per_customer FROM customers c LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id LEFT JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY r.macro_region, ml.level_name ORDER BY sales DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT t.product_category_name_english,ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value),2) AS refund_amt
FROM refunds r JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id=r.refund_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id=ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english HAVING SUM(ri.refund_value) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY refund_amt DESC NULLS LAST,t.product_category_name_english ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

WITH campaign_orders AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT cp.campaign_id, cu.order_id
 FROM coupon_usages cu JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id=cu.coupon_id
 JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=cu.order_id
 WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
), item_totals AS (
 SELECT order_id,SUM(price) AS sales FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT ca.campaign_id,COUNT(co.order_id) AS used_orders,ROUND(SUM(it.sales),2) AS gmv
FROM campaigns ca LEFT JOIN campaign_orders co ON co.campaign_id=ca.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN item_totals it ON it.order_id=co.order_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id ORDER BY gmv DESC NULLS LAST,ca.campaign_id LIMIT 10;

SELECT sl.keyword,t.product_category_name_english,COUNT(*) AS clicks
FROM search_logs sl JOIN products p ON p.product_id=sl.clicked_product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
WHERE sl.clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sl.keyword,t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY clicks DESC,sl.keyword ASC NULLS LAST,t.product_category_name_english ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.warehouse_id,w.region_code,pbm.brand_id,COUNT(*) AS low_stock_items
FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id=i.product_id AND pbm.is_current
WHERE i.quantity<i.safety_stock
GROUP BY i.warehouse_id,w.region_code,pbm.brand_id
ORDER BY low_stock_items DESC,i.warehouse_id,w.region_code,pbm.brand_id ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

SELECT st.seller_id,COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_category_name_english) AS category_cnt,
 ROUND(SUM(si.commission_amount),2) AS commission
FROM settlements st JOIN settlement_items si ON si.settlement_id=st.settlement_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=si.order_id AND oi.order_item_id=si.order_item_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
GROUP BY st.seller_id HAVING SUM(si.commission_amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY commission DESC NULLS LAST,st.seller_id LIMIT 20;

SELECT ut.tag_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_item_price FROM user_tags ut LEFT JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.tag_id = ut.tag_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id = utm.member_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY ut.tag_id ORDER BY members DESC LIMIT 201

WITH ranked AS (SELECT ms.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC, snapshot_id DESC) AS rn FROM member_snapshot ms WHERE snapshot_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT ml_cur.level_name AS current_level, ml_snap.level_name AS snapshot_level, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_cnt FROM ranked ms JOIN members m ON m.member_id = ms.member_id LEFT JOIN member_levels ml_cur ON ml_cur.level_id = m.level_id LEFT JOIN member_levels ml_snap ON ml_snap.level_id = ms.level_id WHERE ms.rn = 1 AND ml_cur.level_id IS NOT NULL AND ml_snap.level_id IS NOT NULL AND ms.level_id <> m.level_id GROUP BY ml_cur.level_name, ml_snap.level_name ORDER BY member_cnt DESC LIMIT 201

SELECT t.product_category_name_english,r.reason_code,
 COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refunds,ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value),2) AS amt
FROM refunds r JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id=r.refund_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id=ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english,r.reason_code HAVING SUM(ri.refund_value) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY amt DESC NULLS LAST,t.product_category_name_english ASC NULLS LAST,r.reason_code ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

SELECT sa.state AS addr_state, c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM shipping_addresses sa
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = sa.customer_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE sa.is_default
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY orders DESC,1 ASC NULLS LAST,2 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')), item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS gmv FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT vo.customer_unique_id) AS buyers, ROUND(SUM(it.gmv) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS aov FROM valid_orders vo LEFT JOIN item_totals it ON it.order_id = vo.order_id LIMIT 201

WITH first_order AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1), cohort AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', first_ts)::date AS cohort_month FROM first_order WHERE first_ts >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND first_ts < DATE '2017-07-01'), returner AS (SELECT DISTINCT co.customer_unique_id, co.cohort_month FROM cohort co JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01') SELECT co.cohort_month, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(re.customer_unique_id) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct FROM cohort co LEFT JOIN returner re ON re.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS on_time_pct FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

WITH sold AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS n FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')), allp AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * s.n / NULLIF(a.n, 0), 2) AS sell_through_pct FROM sold s CROSS JOIN allp a LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.freight_value) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 0), 2) AS freight_pct FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY freight_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH coupon_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount FROM coupon_usages GROUP BY order_id), order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS order_gmv FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(ot.order_gmv), 2) AS gmv, ROUND(SUM(ct.discount_amount), 2) AS discount, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ct.discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(ot.order_gmv), 0), 2) AS discount_pct FROM coupon_totals ct JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ct.order_id JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.order_id = ct.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

SELECT st.category_id, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600.0 <= tc.sla_hours) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS sla_pct FROM support_tickets st LEFT JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id GROUP BY st.category_id ORDER BY sla_pct LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS conversion_pct, ROUND(SUM(reward_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS reward_per_converted FROM referrals LIMIT 201

WITH state_times AS (
 SELECT c.customer_state,ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(
 o.order_delivered_customer_date-o.order_purchase_timestamp))/86400.0),2) AS avg_days
 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
 WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state
)
SELECT customer_state,avg_days FROM state_times WHERE avg_days IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY avg_days DESC,customer_state ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH seller_rate AS (SELECT st.seller_id, SUM(si.gross_amount) AS gross, SUM(si.commission_amount) AS commission, SUM(si.commission_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(si.gross_amount), 0) AS rate FROM settlements st JOIN settlement_items si ON si.settlement_id = st.settlement_id GROUP BY st.seller_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(commission) / NULLIF(SUM(gross), 0), 4) AS platform_rate, ROUND(MIN(rate), 4) AS min_seller_rate, ROUND(AVG(rate), 4) AS avg_seller_rate, ROUND(MAX(rate), 4) AS max_seller_rate FROM seller_rate LIMIT 201

WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mo, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), months AS (SELECT generate_series(1, 12) AS mo) SELECT m.mo, ROUND(m17.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2017, ROUND(m18.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2018, ROUND(100.0 * (m18.gmv - m17.gmv) / NULLIF(m17.gmv, 0), 2) AS yoy_pct FROM months m LEFT JOIN monthly m17 ON m17.mo = m.mo AND m17.yr = 2017 LEFT JOIN monthly m18 ON m18.mo = m.mo AND m18.yr = 2018 ORDER BY m.mo LIMIT 201

WITH reason_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT reason_code, order_id FROM refunds) SELECT r.reason_code, ROUND(AVG(rev.review_score), 2) AS avg_score, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rev.review_score <= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS low_score_pct FROM reason_orders r JOIN order_reviews rev ON rev.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY r.reason_code ORDER BY low_score_pct DESC LIMIT 201
